scripts.build: cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=core tsc -b && cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=core vite build
scripts.build:core: cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=core tsc -b && cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=core vite build
scripts.build:client: cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=client tsc -b && cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=client vite build
scripts.build:provider: cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=provider tsc -b && cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=provider vite build
scripts.build:admin: cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=admin tsc -b && cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=admin vite build
scripts.start:all: kill-port 3000 3001 3002 3003 && concurrently -n core,admin,provider,client -c blue,magenta,yellow,green "cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=core vite --port 3000" "cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=admin vite --port 3001" "cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=provider vite --port 3002" "cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=client vite --port 3003"
